claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a Canon DSLR with model marking reading “EOS 800” (partially visible). Photos do not show the lens model/specs (e.g., 18-55mm) or confirm it is a UK used unit.
Witness report: photo 2 shows model marking on body reads “EOS 800” (partially visible), consistent with EOS 800D naming.
Witness report notes lens/mount area visible but does not provide lens model/specs or focal length markings.
Photos show the camera body and rear LCD/button layout, but the report does not confirm cosmetic wear (scratches/dents/rubber wear) or internal condition.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 18-55mm kit lens (could be a different lens or incomplete/defective lens).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens front and side markings showing the exact lens model and focal length (e.g., “18-55mm”) plus a shot of the lens mount connection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only / unknown lens quality (worst case: treat as not the claimed kit lens).

risks.risk: Missing essentials (battery, charger, cables, caps/hood/strap) affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A full laid-out accessories photo showing battery, charger, lens caps/hood, strap, and any cables/memory card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (worst case: no battery/charger included).

risks.risk: Function issues (shutter fault, autofocus problems, viewfinder/LCD defects, sensor dust/fungus).
risks.proof: Short video or clip showing autofocus locking on a subject, plus a test photo at a plain bright background to reveal sensor dust/fungus; also show LCD clarity and viewfinder view.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / potentially faulty (worst case: assume basic functions may be unreliable).

risks.risk: High shutter count or heavy usage leading to earlier wear (especially shutter mechanism).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera menu showing shutter count/usage statistics (or a shutter count app readout).
risks.if_unproven: Price as high-usage (worst case: treat as heavily used).

risks.risk: LCD/viewfinder may be damaged or unclear (scratches, dead pixels, haze) not fully verifiable from the witness shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of LCD (including corners) and viewfinder eyepiece area with the screen on and text visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as LCD/viewfinder condition uncertain (worst case: assume wear/defects).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact lens model by photographing the lens markings (showing focal length like 18-55mm) and the lens front/side clearly.
Show all included items laid out: battery, charger, lens caps/hood, strap, cables, and whether a memory card is included.
Provide a short autofocus test clip (camera focusing on a near and far subject) and a sample test photo.
Send a photo/screenshot of shutter count/usage statistics from the camera menu or a shutter-count tool readout.
Provide close-ups of LCD and viewfinder with the screen on and readable text, plus a sensor test photo (bright plain background) to check dust/fungus.
response.reason: The witness can identify the Canon DSLR body model marking, but key value drivers (lens model/specs, included accessories, and functional/sensor condition) are not verifiable from the reported photos. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
